_chunk.purpose: Canonical scene/location visual descriptions for background generation

neon_district_street.name: Neon District Street

description.overview: Rain-slicked street in the commercial heart of RE:ECHO City. Towering holographic billboards flicker with propaganda. Neon signs in cyan and amber cast reflections on wet pavement. Art deco architecture looms overhead.
description.mood: Oppressive yet alive. The weight of surveillance mixed with desperate hope.

foreground.detail: High detail - this is where characters stand

composition.skyline: Overcast, no stars. Occasional searchlights from Temple district.

lighting.contrast: High - pools of light surrounded by darkness
lighting.reflections: Wet surfaces reflect all light sources, creating streaks of color

color_palette.restriction: 85% grayscale, only cyan and amber as accent colors

objects_present.name: Street Lamp
objects_present.visual: Tall, art deco style with geometric housing. Often flickering.

objects_present.name: Holographic Billboard
objects_present.visual: Large rectangular projections, Temple propaganda or corporate ads

objects_present.name: Steam Vent
objects_present.visual: Metal grates with rising steam, adds atmosphere

npcs_typical.behavior: Moving quickly, avoiding eye contact, huddled in groups

establishing.description: Looking down the length of the street, showing depth and building height

character_focus.description: Slightly below eye level, character framed by neon and architecture

atmospheric.description: Slightly tilted, rain visible, buildings looming oppressively

neon_district_street.generation_prompt: Signal Noir cyberpunk cityscape: Rain-slicked street with towering art deco buildings. Holographic billboards cast cyan light. Neon shop signs in amber. Wet pavement reflects all colors. Steam rises from grates. Dark silhouettes of pedestrians. MANDATORY: 85% grayscale, only cyan and amber accents. Deep black shadows, high contrast noir.

resistance_hq.name: Resistance HQ - War Room

description.overview: Underground bunker converted into resistance nerve center. Holographic tactical displays dominate the central table. Walls lined with salvaged tech, weapons, and maps. Cables run everywhere.
description.mood: Tense focus. The last bastion of hope, well-used and well-defended.

elements: Worn paths from repeated foot traffic

lighting.ambient: Low, creates dramatic shadows on faces during meetings
lighting.aesthetic: Holographic glow illuminating worried faces in darkness

objects_present.name: Tactical Holotable
objects_present.visual: Large circular platform projecting 3D city map in cyan. Controls around edge.

objects_present.name: Weapon Rack
objects_present.visual: Metal scaffolding holding rifles, pistols, melee weapons. Some empty slots.

objects_present.name: Communication Station
objects_present.visual: Multiple screens, headsets, keyboard terminals. Someone always monitoring.

resistance_hq.generation_prompt: Signal Noir underground bunker: Resistance war room with central holographic tactical table glowing cyan. Salvaged tech on walls, exposed cables, weapon racks. Concrete floors worn from use. Harsh artificial lighting from screens. Faces lit by holographics. MANDATORY: 85% grayscale, cyan accents only. Dark, tense atmosphere.

signal_bar.name: The Signal - Felix's Bar

description.overview: A dimly lit watering hole that's seen better days. Art deco bar counter with holographic drink menu. Booths with privacy screens. The place where information changes hands.
description.mood: Weary refuge. Neither Temple nor Resistance territory - neutral ground for dangerous conversations.

bar_counter.materials: Dark wood with brass trim, worn smooth

lighting.ambient: Very low, intimate. Faces half in shadow.
lighting.smoke: Light haze in air, catches light rays

objects_present.name: Bar Counter
objects_present.visual: Long curved counter, dark wood with brass rail. Worn where elbows rest.

objects_present.name: Drink Glasses
objects_present.visual: Various - whiskey tumblers, tall glasses, some empty, some half-full

objects_present.name: Privacy Screen
objects_present.visual: Holographic barrier around booths, translucent cyan, can be opaque on request
